    local function v217(p70)
        local n1 = 0

        for _, child in ipairs(p70:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Frame") or child:IsA("TextButton") then
                local PopScale = child:FindFirstChild("PopScale")

                if PopScale then
                    PopScale.Scale = 0.96
                    task.delay(n1 * 0.03, function()
                        if PopScale.Parent then
                            t5.value3.play(PopScale, "Pop", {
								Scale = 1
							})
                        end
                    end)
                    n1 += 1
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function t5.value26.switchTo(p71)
        if p71 == t5.value26._active then
            return
        end
        if t5.value26._transitioning then
            t5.value26._queued = p71

            return
        end
        t5.value26._transitioning = true
        local _active = t5.value26._active
        t5.value26._active = p71
        for v518, v519 in ipairs(t5.value26._tabs) do

            local play = t5.value3.play
            local button = v519.button
            local v522 = v519 == p71 and t5.value2.textHi or t5.value2.textLo
            local v523 = v519 ~= p71 and 1 or 0
            local bgElevated = t5.value2.bgElevated

            play(button, "Hover", {
				TextColor3 = v522,
				BackgroundTransparency = v523,
				BackgroundColor3 = bgElevated
			})
            t5.value32(v519, v519 == p71)
        end
        t5.value3.play(t5.value29, "Stretch", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 26)
		})
        t5.value3.play(t5.value29, "TabIn", {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, t5.value33(p71))
		}).Completed:Once(function()
            t5.value3.play(t5.value29, "Settle", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 18)
			})
        end)
        local function v525()
            p71.content.Visible = true
            p71.content.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -12)
            p71.content.GroupTransparency = 1
            t5.value3.play(p71.content, "TabIn", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
			})
            v217(p71.container)
            t5.value3.play(p71.content, "TabIn", {
				GroupTransparency = 0
			}).Completed:Once(function()
                t5.value26._transitioning = false

                if t5.value26._queued then
                    local _queued = t5.value26._queued

                    t5.value26._queued = nil
                    t5.value26.switchTo(_queued)
                end
            end)
        end
        if _active then
            t5.value3.play(_active.content, "TabOut", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16)
			})
            t5.value3.play(_active.content, "TabOut", {
				GroupTransparency = 1
			}).Completed:Once(function()
                _active.content.Visible = false
                v525()
            end)

            return
        end
        v525()
    end

    local function v220()
        if t5.value37 and t5.value37.Parent then
            return t5.value37
        end

        local PlayerGui2 = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")

        if not PlayerGui2 then
            return nil
        end

        for _, descendant in ipairs(PlayerGui2:GetDescendants()) do
            if not (descendant:IsA("TextButton") or descendant:IsA("ImageButton")) then
                continue
            end

            local v529 = string.lower(descendant.Name)
            local v530 = descendant:IsA("TextButton") and string.lower(descendant.Text) or ""
            local v531 = v529 == "block"

            if not v531 then
                v531 = v529 == "blockbutton"

                if not v531 then
                    v531 = string.find(v529, "block")

                    if not v531 then
                        v531 = string.find(v530, "block")

                        if not v531 then
                            v531 = string.find(v529, "defesa") or string.find(v529, "guard")
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if v531 then
                return descendant
            end
        end

        return nil
    end
    local function v221(p72)
        if p72 == t5.value34._blocking then
            return
        end

        t5.value34._blocking = p72

        local v533 = v220()

        if v533 and firesignal then
            pcall(function()
                if p72 then
                    firesignal(v533.MouseButton1Down)
                    pcall(function()
                        local _firesignal = firesignal
                        local InputBegan = v533.InputBegan
                        local Touch = Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                        local Begin = Enum.UserInputState.Begin

                        _firesignal(InputBegan, {
							UserInputType = Touch,
							UserInputState = Begin
						})
                    end)
                    pcall(function()
                        firesignal(v533.TouchTap)
                    end)

                    return
                end

                firesignal(v533.MouseButton1Up)
                pcall(function()
                    local _firesignal = firesignal
                    local InputEnded3 = v533.InputEnded
                    local Touch = Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                    local End = Enum.UserInputState.End

                    _firesignal(InputEnded3, {
						UserInputType = Touch,
						UserInputState = End
					})
                end)
            end)

            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(p72, t5.value34.blockKey, false, game)
        end)
    end

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

    end)

    local function v222()

    local function v223(p73)
        if not p73 or not p73.Parent then
            return false
        end

        local Humanoid = p73:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if not Humanoid then
            return false
        end

        local Animator = Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

        if not Animator then
            return false
        end

        local GetPlayingAnimationTracks = Animator.GetPlayingAnimationTracks

        for _, v in ipairs(GetPlayingAnimationTracks(Animator)) do
            local Animation = v.Animation

            if Animation then

    function t5.value67()
        if not t5.value63.locked then
            return
        end

        local CurrentCamera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

        if not t5.value63.target or not t5.value65(t5.value63.target) then
            local v678 = v236()

            t5.value63.target = v678

            return

        local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

            if v683.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                local cFrame = CFrame.lookAt(v682 - v683.Unit * 12.5, v679)
                local v685 = v679 - CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position

                if v685.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                    local v686 = not (CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(v685.Unit) < 0.98) and 0.12 or 0.35

                    CurrentCamera.CFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame:Lerp(cFrame, v686)

        else
            local CFramePosition = CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position

            if (v679 - CFramePosition).Magnitude > 0.001 then
                local cFrame = CFrame.lookAt(CFramePosition, v679)

                CurrentCamera.CFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame:Lerp(cFrame, 0.35)
            end
        end
    end

    t5.value102 = Instance.new("Part")
    t5.value102.Size = Vector3.new(20000, 10, 20000)
    t5.value102.Position = Vector3.new(-18, -52, -135)
    t5.value102.Anchored = true
    t5.value102.Transparency = 1
    t5.value102.CanCollide = false
    t5.value102.Parent = Workspace
    t5.value1:track(t5.value102)
    t5.value103 = false
    t5.value6.Toggle(container5, "Anti Void", function(p110)
        if p110 ~= t5.value103 then
            t5.value103 = not t5.value103
            t5.value102.CanCollide = t5.value103

            local _ = t5.value103
        end
    end, false)
    getgenv().climbWallsEnabled = false
    getgenv().climbWallsConnection = nil

    function t5.value104()
        getgenv().climbWallsEnabled = not getgenv().climbWallsEnabled

        if getgenv().climbWallsConnection then
            getgenv().climbWallsConnection:Disconnect()
            getgenv().climbWallsConnection = nil
        end

        if getgenv().climbWallsEnabled then
            getgenv().climbWallsConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

                if not Character then
                    return
                end

                local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                if not HumanoidRootPart or not Humanoid then
                    return
                end

                local v865 = false
                local v866 = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)

                if not v866 then
                    v866 = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Up)
                end

                if v866 then
                    local raycastResult = Workspace:Raycast(HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 2, (function()
                        local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()

                        raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Character }
                        raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist

                        return raycastParams
                    end)())

                    if raycastResult and raycastResult.Normal.Y == 0 then
                        Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
                        HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 25, 0)
                        v865 = true
                        if Character:FindFirstChild("Animate") then
                            local fall = Character.Animate:FindFirstChild("fall")

                            if fall then
                                fall:Destroy()
                            end
                        end
                        if not Character:FindFirstChild("ClimbAnim") then
                            local Animation = Instance.new("Animation")

                            Animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://180436334"
                            Animation.Name = "ClimbAnim"
                            Animation.Parent = Character
                        end
                        local v870 = false
                        for v873, v874 in ipairs(Humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do

                            if v874.Animation.AnimationId == "rbxassetid://180436334" then
                                v870 = true
                            end

                            if v874.Animation.AnimationId == "rbxassetid://180436117" then
                                v874:Stop()
                            end
                        end
                        if not v870 then
                            Humanoid:LoadAnimation(Character:FindFirstChild("ClimbAnim")):Play()
                        end
                    end
                end

                if not v865 then
                    for _, v in ipairs(Humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                        if v.Animation.AnimationId == "rbxassetid://180436334" then
                            v:Stop()
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            t5.value1:track(getgenv().climbWallsConnection)
        end

        return getgenv().climbWallsEnabled
    end

    t5.value6.Toggle(container5, "Climb Walls", function(p111)
        if p111 ~= getgenv().climbWallsEnabled then
            t5.value104()
        end
    end, false)
    t5.value6.Button(container5, "Invade Domain", function()
        local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

        if Character then
            local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if HumanoidRootPart then
                HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame + Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector * 10
            end
        end
    end)

    local container6 = t5.value26.registerTab("Settings", t18.Settings).container

    t5.value6.KeybindPicker(container6, "Menu Toggle Key", "LeftControl")
    t5.value6.Button(container6, "Save Config", function()
    end)
    t5.value6.Button(container6, "Load Config", function()
    end)
    t5.value6.Button(container6, "Unload JJS", function()
        pcall(function()
            v230()
        end)
        pcall(function()
            RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("JJS_BF_Aimbot")
        end)
        pcall(function()
            t5.value66()
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if t5.value63 and t5.value63.gui then
                t5.value63.gui:Destroy()
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            _G.lb = nil
        end)
        t5.value1:unload()
        pcall(function()
            t5.value45:Destroy()
        end)
        pcall(function()
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player.Character then
                    for _, child in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Highlight") or child:IsA("BillboardGui") and child:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel") then
                            child:Destroy()
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        t5.value7:Destroy()
        t5.value12:Destroy()
    end)

    local value1_10 = t5.value1
    local t26 = { UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        if gameProcessed then
            return
        end

        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
            local value17 = t5.value17

            t5.value18(not value17)
        end
    end) }

    value1_10:track(v1(t26))
    task.spawn(function()
        t5.value3.play(t5.value9, "IntroFade", {
			GroupTransparency = 0
		})
        t5.value3.play(t5.value9, "Intro", {
			Size = t5.value8
		})
        task.delay(0.12, function()
            for i, v in ipairs(t5.value26._tabs) do
                local v883 = v
                local button = v883.button
                local buttonPosition = button.Position

                button.Position = buttonPosition - UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0)
                button.TextTransparency = 1
                t5.value31(v883, "Press", 1)
                task.delay((i - 1) * 0.04, function()
                    t5.value3.play(button, "TabIn", {
						Position = buttonPosition,
						TextTransparency = 0
					})
                    t5.value31(v883, "TabIn", 0.35)
                end)
            end
        end)
        task.delay(0.25, function()
            t5.value26.switchTo(t5.value26._tabs[1])
            task.wait(0.3)
            t5.value29.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, t5.value33(t5.value26._tabs[1]))
        end)
    end)
    print("[JJS Interface] Loaded")
end
